test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

The ticket collector asked the passenger why he had not purchased a full ticket for his daughter.

options.text: The ticket collector said to the passenger, “Why haven’t you purchase a full ticket for your daughter?”
The ticket collector said to the passenger, “Why didn’t you purchase a full ticket for your daughter?”
The ticket collector said to the passenger, “Why he had not purchased a full ticket for his daughter?”
The ticket collector said to the passenger, “Why haven’t you purchased a full ticket for his daughter?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The direct form of speech requires the exact words spoken to be **quoted.**
 
• The verb tense in the direct form should match the original question's tense.
 
• Option 2 correctly transforms the indirect statement into a direct question with appropriate** punctuation and tense **and follows correct format of direct speech.
 
• Narration (direct format) has two parts i.e
 
 
• **Reported verb - 'The ticket collector said to the passenger,'**
 
• **Reported Speech - “Why didn’t you purchase a full ticket for your daughter?”**
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is ''**The ticket collector said to the passenger, “Why didn’t you purchase a full ticket for your daughter?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When converting indirect speech to direct speech, it is crucial to ensure the** pronouns and verb tenses** are appropriately adjusted.
 
• **Quotation marks** are used to enclose the exact words spoken in direct speech.
